records.currentScene:
Before
Show result

Hold the Channel button (3,8), a page you are not on, for about two seconds, then release it. Mosaic sends Note Off for every one of the 128 notes on all 16 MIDI channels of each of the three connected ports, 6,144 messages. Nothing was sounding, so you hear no change and the screen stays on Song; the sweep only matters when a note is stuck. Holding the button of the page you are already on does nothing. Playback is not stopped by a panic.

04 / MUSICAL EXAMPLES
Musical examples
RECIPE 01
Silence connected MIDI notes from Song view with the Channel panic gesture

Use this on a connected MIDI instrument when a note is stuck. The panic gesture sends note-release messages to connected MIDI outputs, but it does not stop the sequencer. The manual’s captured Output strip replays a recorded result; it does not send messages to your instrument.

Open Song at (6,8), so Channel is an inactive page button.
Hold Channel at (3,8) until the panic gesture fires, then release. The page remains Song.
A stuck MIDI note should stop; inspect the release messages in Output. The sequencer keeps running, so new notes may still play. Press Stop separately if you want silence to continue.

Use Silence a sounding note for the long-note comparison. The other examples show the gesture from a silent project.
